title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account and application preferences
calendarHint: Dates across the dashboard. Ethiopian calendar is expected by Amharic-speaking staff.
languageHint: Follows you between terminals. Emails and SMS use this locale too.
notificationsHint: Choose channels, quiet hours, and whether alerts wait for a digest.
quietHoursHint: Inbox still fills. Email, SMS, and push pause until morning.
digestHint: Bundle email into a summary instead of sending each alert immediately.
pushEnabled: This browser will alert you to unassigned rides with the tab in the background.
pushUnavailable: Web push is not configured on the server (missing VAPID keys).
pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser.
staleSettings: Settings were updated elsewhere. Reload to see the latest.
